question: In ΔXYZ, I is the incentre of the ΔXYZ. If ∠XYZ = 40 degree, then what is the value of ∠XIZ?
solution:
Given:

In ΔXYZ, I is the incentre.

∠XYZ = 40

Concepts used: 

Angle formed at incentre opposite to given side = 90° +( ½ × angle opposite to given side)

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa581cf6957a714474d78091fd6dc8eb672c3fb544f659217a3399b34e80ddbb.png] 

In ΔXYZ, I is the incentre

∠XIZ = 90° + ( ½ × ∠XYZ)

⇒ ∠XIZ = 90° + ( ½ × 40)

⇒ ∠XIZ = 90° + 20°

⇒ ∠XIZ = 110° 

∴ Measure of ∠XIZ is equal to 110°.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
